steps.label: Start
steps.note:
Everyone spread in Quickmarch positions, with the bottom 3 between East/West & SE/SW like so, & tanks above them. (Melees take SW/SE for positionals)

Center will soon be unsafe & Exa-Ring transition begins soon once again.

If using 2mins later, LB1 ASAP. If you've spent 2mins in P3, LB3 whenever comfy.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 1a
steps.note:
Omega will begin to cast Wave Cannon, starting the first of three Cannon cycles, in addition to starting a wave of Exa-Rings. (Done through each Cannon cycle)

Near the end of the cast, two random players will be given Line/LP stack markers. DO NOT MOVE FROM YOUR SPREAD SPOT YET

steps.label: Wave Cannon 1b
steps.note:
Initial Wave Cannon beams resolve & bait a 2nd beam in the same spot, so the party will move South to the safe spot to resolve line-stacks.

If either side has 2 stacks, the South-most stack flexes, & the non-stack melee fills.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 1c
steps.note:
Move South, and be ready to soak stacks.

The repeat Protean hit will glow right before the stack snapshots.

*Optionally*: if a tank recieves the stack marker, they can head North & solo the hit, w/ the party stacking on the remaining marker, saving some heals & mit.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 1d
steps.note: Stacks resolve & proteans hit a 2nd time, w/ the 1st Exa-Ring(Center) glowing.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 2a
steps.note: Return to your quickmarch positions & get on the *3rd* outer ring for an Exa-Ring dodge w/ your next protean.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 2b
steps.note:
Proteans will go out right *after* the 2nd Exa-Ring goes off, so head/JP dodge in at your position as soon as you see the animation.

If either side has 2 stacks, the South-most stack flexes, & the non-stack melee fills.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 2c
steps.note:
Move South, and be ready to soak stacks and handle the Exa-Rings by sitting inside the rings you just ran into.

The repeat Protean hit will glow right before the stack snapshots.

*Optionally*: if a tank recieves the stack marker, they can head North & solo the hit, w/ the party stacking on the remaining marker, saving some heals & mit.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 2d
steps.note: Stacks resolve & proteans hit a 2nd time. Get ready to head back to your positions for the 3rd round.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 3a
steps.note:
Return to your quickmarch positions & get ready to head South again.

If either side has 2 stacks, the South-most stack flexes, & the non-stack melee fills.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 3b
steps.note:
Beams resolve & 1st Exa-Ring starts glowing again. Start moving South to the safe spots.

If either side has 2 stacks, the South-most stack flexes, & the non-stack melee fills.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 3c
steps.note:
Move South, and be ready to soak stacks, whilst standing on the *3rd* outer ring waiting for Exa-Rings to resolve.

The repeat Protean hit will glow right before the stack snapshots.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 3d
steps.note:
Stacks resolve, proteans hit a 2nd time, & the 1st Exa-Ring hits.

Wait on the *3rd* outer ring for the next Exa-Ring hit before moving in.

steps.label: Wave Cannon 3e
steps.note: Once you see the next Exa-Ring hit, move in/JP dodge inside to finish the mechanic.

steps.label: Enrage
steps.note:
Stay inside, resolving Exa-Rings, as right after Omega will cast Blue Screen, the Intermissions Enrage at ~54-55s.

Omega must be *below* 20% before Blue Screen finishes to pass into Phase 5:
https://ff14.toolboxgaming.space/?id=788186687294761&preview=1
